Question B-008-005-011.

Why the correct answer is right: A low-pass filter attenuates frequencies above its cut-off while passing frequencies below it.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Band-pass": A band-pass filter passes a range between lower and upper limits; it is not defined by attenuating only above one cut-off.
- sourceIndex 2: "High-pass": A high-pass filter does the opposite: it attenuates below its cut-off and passes higher frequencies.
- sourceIndex 3: "Notch": A notch filter attenuates one narrow frequency rather than all frequencies above a cut-off.
